title: refuses a patches/ffmpeg/.patches that lists a patch the pins do not hold
why: A patch Electron applies to FFmpeg that the pins do not hold: the source archive would lack a change to the shipped library.

title: refuses a pinned patches/ffmpeg patch that the list does not name
why: A pinned FFmpeg patch Electron no longer applies: the archive would offer a change the library does not carry.

title: reads a listed name that begins with a dash as a name, not a grep option
why: A listed name read as a grep option: a name made to match another's pattern passes as pinned, so the archive lacks a patch the list names.

title: matches a patches/ffmpeg/.patches with CRLF line ends in both directions
why: A list with CRLF line ends no name of which matches a pinned one: every cached archive built from it is refused, or its names are never compared.

title: refuses an archive with no patches/ffmpeg/.patches, naming it
why: A missing list read as an empty one: the pinned patches would then be refused for not being listed, or none checked at all.

title: checks the list of FFmpeg patches in the fetch and in --verify
why: --verify without the list check: a cached archive missing a patch the library carries verifies and is attached to a release.

title: parses under the system bash, whatever its version
why: A bare case pattern inside $( ... ) is a syntax error to macOS's bash 3.2, so every --verify on a Mac runner exits 2.
